brief: 5 AI writing tools that out-write expensive copywriters every time.

slots.desc1: The universal standard for drafting headlines and long-form sales copy.
slots.desc2: Anthropic’s writer with unmatched tone control and human-like nuance.
slots.desc3: Enterprise-grade marketing campaigns with built-in brand voice training.
slots.desc4: Social posts, emails, and ads generated from a single brief.
slots.desc5: Real-time clarity and tone fixes that polish rough drafts instantly.

slots.toolTagline: The conversational engine that drafts anything from tweets to whitepapers.
slots.bigStatement: ChatGPT turns a single prompt into full funnel copy in under 60 seconds.
slots.use1Body: Generate hero headlines and benefit bullets that actually convert visitors.
slots.use2Body: Write seven-day nurture sequences with subject lines and strong CTAs included.
slots.use3Body: Spin up ten variant hooks for Facebook and Google ads instantly.

slots.toolTagline: Anthropic’s writer with unmatched tone control and human-like nuance.
slots.bigStatement: Claude writes 2000-word articles that read like a senior strategist wrote them.
slots.use1Body: Draft in-depth SEO articles with natural transitions and zero fluff filler.
slots.use2Body: Build persuasive pitch decks and executive summaries from bullet points.
slots.use3Body: Train consistent tone guidelines and rewrite existing copy to match.

slots.toolTagline: The marketing platform built for teams scaling conversion copy.
slots.bigStatement: Jasper automates multi-channel campaigns while locking in your exact brand voice.
slots.use1Body: Turn one brief into LinkedIn posts, landing pages, and video scripts.
slots.use2Body: Generate conversion-focused variants for headlines and call-to-action buttons.
slots.use3Body: Write Surfer-optimized blog posts that rank without awkward keyword stuffing.

slots.toolTagline: GTM platform that turns raw ideas into sales-ready messaging fast.
slots.bigStatement: Copy.ai builds entire sales decks and outbound sequences from a one-line value prop.
slots.use1Body: Personalize LinkedIn and email intros at scale without sounding robotic.
slots.use2Body: Create battle cards, one-pagers, and follow-up scripts for reps instantly.
slots.use3Body: Generate launch copy, FAQ, and announcement posts from a single prompt.

slots.toolTagline: SEO and ad specialist that publishes Google-ready content automatically.
slots.bigStatement: Writesonic drafts rankable articles with real-time data and internal linking built in.
slots.use1Body: Research, write, and optimize five-thousand-word posts with citations included.
slots.use2Body: Generate RSAs and keyword-focused landing page copy that lowers CPC.
slots.use3Body: Build conversational sales bot flows that qualify leads while you sleep.

slots.toolTagline: The workspace writer that turns scattered notes into polished deliverables.
slots.bigStatement: Notion AI transforms messy brainstorming into structured briefs and ready-to-ship docs.
slots.use1Body: Instantly summarize action items and draft follow-up emails from raw notes.
slots.use2Body: Turn bullet outlines into complete SOPs and team knowledge base entries.
slots.use3Body: Generate announcement drafts directly inside your content calendar database.

slots.body: These six tools replace a $5k monthly copywriting retainer. Start with the free tiers and scale what converts.
